content_metadata.description: The video explores reasons behind a surprising statistic from a poll indicating that 60% of clinicians do not want their children to pursue a career in medicine, contrasting it with increasing interest among young people. Through data analysis and personal anecdotes, it discusses challenges in the medical profession, including generational and gender perspectives.

youtube_description:
The question I have for you, if you work in healthcare, is would you let your children (or friends and family) go into medicine knowing what you currently know!?  That is ultimately the question I pose during this video, and I do a deep dive on different clinicians thoughts on this topic.  As we all know, healthcare has changed quite a bit, especially in the last 2 years.  My goal of this video is to do a deep dive to see if we would recommend working in the current healthcare environment to someone we love.  I think you'll be surprised by the results I go over in this video!
